Massacre everyone as an anomalous entity, raid the facility as an invading insurgency, protect the Foundation as a Task Force soldier, lay waste to the EVERYTHING as Valravn, or simply evade and escape. It's up to you.

Drop Item - (Keyboard: Q) (Controller: Down)
Sprint - (Keyboard: Left Shift) (Controller: Left Trigger)
